title: Simple loop and linked-queue Java assignments
summary: Students in an introductory Java course write a simple while-loop program in week two and implement a linked-list Queue interface in week seven. Researchers later test GPT-4 Turbo feedback on authentic submissions; students did not receive that experimental feedback.

sources.title: Feedback-Generation for Programming Exercises With GPT-4
sources.evidence_quote: Two assignments from an introductory programming course were selected, and GPT-4 was asked to generate feedback for 55 randomly chosen, authentic student programming submissions.

assessment.summary: Students in an introductory Java course write a simple while-loop program in week two and implement a linked-list Queue interface in week seven.
